text: とって　きた　ばかりの　ポケモン　たたかわせよう　かな！

structure.jp: とって　きた　ばかりの　ポケモン
たたかわせよう　かな！

patterns.name: 〜たばかり
patterns.span: とって　きた　ばかりの　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a past verb says the thing happened only a moment ago; の then ties it to the thing described. とって きた ばかりの ポケモン = 'the Pokémon I just went and caught'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing たたかう to たたかわせる means making or letting someone else do the fighting. たたかわせよう = 'I'll have it battle'.

patterns.name: 〜ようかな
patterns.span: たたかわせよう　かな
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form of a verb plus かな is thinking aloud about maybe doing something. たたかわせよう かな = 'maybe I'll have it battle'.
